about:
Metal Works Corporation was incorporated in 1956 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The company has operated for more than 65 years as a specialty metal fabrication and manufacturing firm. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company operates an in-house machine shop producing specialty springs from wire diameters of 0.002 to 2 inches across all alloys, custom rotating mechanical seals, and various industrial components. Its capabilities span pipe and tube bending, coiling, welding, general fabrication, and custom coil design. Specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Metal Works serves industrial customers requiring fabricated metal components, springs, and seals. The company describes itself as customer-oriented but does not list specific industries or named clients in its public materials.

The firm emphasizes its unique in-house capabilities and broad spectrum of bending, coiling, welding, and fabrication services as differentiators. It was founded to provide specialty metal fabrication, though the specific founding mission is not detailed.
